svg.text: Side section through the body axis, front elevation and plan section. All dimensions in mm. Sized by the v0.2 simulations for 3–5 L/h on a 100 W USB-C supply with a 99 Wh battery.
A · Side section through body axis (front of product on the left)
Display and two touch keys sit on the cap chamfer, angled 30° up toward the user.
C · Plan section at z = 120 (front at top)
Rings from the centre: heater block, HX coil (amber), insulation,
body-coil runs (blue) in shell grooves, finned aluminium shell.
D · Parts in the section (numbers match A)
Immersion heater H2, 12 V ~40 W cartridge in SS316 thermowell: keeps the
Boil zone: open, vented, ~4 min mean residence (270–330 mL); lime forms
Candle filter in the calm zone: pleated cellulose (11 µm) on SS316 core,
~150 cm², lifts out by its bail
Sludge sump: settled lime and plastic, ~25 mL per 100 L at 180 mg/L
hardness; rinse when the app says
Heater block H1: Al 6061 block, 2 × 12 V 40 W cartridges, SS316 tube
Counterflow exchanger: 1/4" in 3/8" SS316L tube-in-tube, 4.1 m, Ø120
mean, 11 turns; hot inside, cold in annulus
Body coil: 1/4" SS316L serpentine (~2.4 m) pressed into axial grooves of
Insulation: 4–10 mm aerogel blanket around core and HX; mica sheet on the
Shell: 6063-T5 aluminium extrusion Ø160 × 2.5 mm, 24 × 8 mm fins, black
Vent condenser: cold feed line coiled round the steam vent; recovers ~70%
1.28" round IPS display + 2 capacitive keys on the cap chamfer
Twist-lock top hatch with interlock (stays locked while calm zone > 50
Detachable SS316 spout nozzle, 160 mm clear above the grate
3-way motorised ball valve (SS304/316 body, 12 V): dispense, or return to
Main PCB: ESP32-S3, USB-C PD charger, heater/pump/valve drivers, safety
Battery: 4S2P 18650 Li-ion, 3.45 Ah cells, 14.4 V / 99 Wh, with 4S BMS
Peristaltic pump, 12 V, 12–155 mL/min, food-grade tube; sits on the cold
E · Key dimensions and figures (from the v0.2 simulations)
290 W × 230 D × 420 H mm; fits under a 600 mm wall-cabinet gap
3–5 L/h after a ~17 min cold start; 1.5 L side tank = one run
~54 W steady at 4 L/h, ~66 W at 5 L/h; 150 W installed for
145 mm head from calm-zone surface to spout; ~60 mm used by
pipes, ~85 mm left for the filter
~5.3 kg dry (est.): HX tubes 1.2, shell 1.3, heater block 0.3,
Shell ~28–30 °C at 25 °C room; cap insulated from the 100 °C core
~28 °C at 25 °C room (≈ room + 3 °C); can't go below room
